name: reflex
description: Paul's reflex layer — deterministic guardrails (PreToolUse/SessionStart/Stop hooks) that activate procedural knowledge at the point of action, plus a role agent that carries doctrine straight into the system prompt. Active hooks: clean-orchestrator (#6, warn via additionalContext), git -C (#2 — silent auto-rewrite of `cd && git` to `git -C` for read-only git via updatedInput/allow), search-before-write (#3, on basic-memory writes), retrieval-logger (logs basic-memory reads), recall served by the `exo` engine on SessionStart (exo-recall.sh, ~10ms from SQLite — replaces the basic-memory CLI path and its TTL cache) plus remind + `exo index` on Stop (indexing runs at session close, never in the startup hot path). zero-residuo (git add -A/.), verify-before-done (commits without a recent green test) and the git-C warn fallback are now log-only sensors — measurement channel, no agent-facing warning, feeding the false-positive tooling. New: the `executor` role agent (dispatched as reflex:executor) carries the executor doctrine (verify-before-done, git -C, explicit git add, notes-to-file) directly in its system prompt with `model` pinned to sonnet. Plus the recon-first and consolida skills (KB budget check, promotion to core). Abstain-by-default.
